label: Senior React / Frontend Developer
positioning: Senior frontend engineer with deep React and JavaScript experience across healthcare workflows, Shopify applications, complex forms, data-rich administration interfaces, and frontend tooling modernization.
summaryInstructions: Lead with long-running React, JavaScript, and frontend product experience.
Emphasize complex workflows, forms, state management, GraphQL integration, and reusable UI patterns.
Use the Vite migration and Playwright-backed integration testing as engineering-quality evidence.
Mention server-rendered JSX and htmx selectively for roles interested in performance or modern web architecture.
Do not claim WCAG expertise until implementation evidence exists.

coverLetterStrategy.opening: Connect the employer's user experience and product challenges to Fred's experience with complex, data-driven interfaces.
avoid: Calling accessibility a professional strength before evidence exists
Presenting visual design as a primary specialty without supporting work

resumeRules.includeProjectsWhen: Include a polished public frontend project or case study when it strengthens visible UI evidence.
